activity.notes: Hamid Idris Awate is commemorated in Eritrean historiography as the commander who launched the armed independence struggle on 1 September 1961. He remained a guerrilla leader until his death on 28 May 1962. ATLAS uses Eritrea as the represented political community rather than Ethiopia, the state against which the independence movement fought.

sources.title: Hamed Idris Awate and the Launch of the Armed Struggle for Liberation — Eritrea Ministry of Information
sources.citation_text: The Eritrean Ministry of Information identifies Awate with the launch of armed struggle on 1 September 1961 and describes his leadership in the liberation movement.
